# Daily AI Eval — 2026-09-29 (America/Vancouver)

**Core question: Is the code making our AI usage better or worse?**
**Answer: YES — improving on resilience; Chat volume still too thin for strong effectiveness.**

## Budget

- **Grok Bot:** last spoken 0% used (Mon 2026-09-28 ~9:17 AM PT, post-reset). Next reset Mon 2026-10-05 ~8:00 AM PT (~6.05 days left). Soft daily max ≈ 16.53% left/day if 100% remaining. Used-to-date from that spoken: ~0%. No new spoken % today (not invented).
- **OpenRouter:** balance ≈ $19.06 (credits 260 − usage 240.94). Live key: day $0.0000 / week $0.1393 / month $40.8621 vs soft caps $1.65 / $11.50 / $50. Under all caps. Sep 28 context was ≈$19.20 balance / ≈$40.72 month — now ≈$19.06 / $40.86.
- **Super Grok:** guard remaining 13%, used_yesterday 24% (≥ daily_cap 4%) → **locked off today**. Reset ≈ 2026-10-01 10:31 AM PT. Hermes xai-oauth this week: 205 API calls / 33.8M tokens (2 sessions). No new spoken Super Grok % found.

## Code changes since last routine report (~2026-09-28 06:53 AM PT)

aisystem branch `fix-ai-generate-pipe-model` (main only has older hop-ordering commit; HelpDesk TT merge conflicts unrelated):

- **41df5e2ad / fe307eb58 — fallback hops past same-vendor 429s / parse fixes** → verdict: **improved** (Router walks past same pool; tests added). Evidence: fallover card live; hop ordering in production path.
- **046e2f739 — model failover + safety (chains, circuits, soft caps, fallover ledger)** → verdict: **improved**. Evidence: Sep 28 16:40 PT chat turn failed on dead `nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b:free` (404) then answered on `cohere/north-mini-code:free` (attempt 2); `answered_after_failover=1`, open circuits=[].
- **c810d9770 — harm refusal, UsageMonitor effectiveness/fallover cards, schema** → verdict: **improved** (visibility). Evidence: `/ai/usage_live` returns fallover/effectiveness surfaces; anomalies list error spikes.
- **e3b877edc / c9bc732f5 — usage/health timestamp chores** → verdict: **no effect** on quality.
- **Uncommitted:** ModelCatalog + Router default free catalog swap dead nano → `nemotron-3-nano-omni-…-reasoning:free` + changelog → verdict: **too little data** (not live until committed/reloaded); chains file already lists nano in `removed`.

## Scorecard trend

- **App ledger days=1 window (since 2026-09-28 00:00):** 2 calls, ok_rate 50%, cost $0.0002, 1×404 then 1×ok via failover. Hermes org: 291 API calls / $0.1625 / 3 sessions / 43.9M tokens.
- **vs 7-day app baseline:** 36 calls, ok 19 (52.8%), errors 17, cost $0.1381. Org: 2442 calls (2406 Hermes), $0.4728.
- **vs 14-day app:** 39 calls, ok 22 (56.4%), cost $0.1381. Org cost $1.0064.
- **Day-over-day:** No 2026-09-28 AI-usage-monitor daily in inbox (gap; last monitor daily 2026-09-25). Sep 28 had a model-failover rollout eval instead. App volume remains low; resilience path is the real delta.

### Thrash / effectiveness

- **Thrash:** none in 1d or 7d anomalies (no ≥20 calls / 15 min same user+provider+model).
- **Effectiveness (≥10 calls rule):** no model reached ≥10 app calls with mixed outcomes in window.
  - `google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free`: 7/7 errors (100%) — anomaly error_spike; still in chat/docs/title chains → **watch / propose remove** (<10 so not formal replace).
  - `nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b:free`: 5/5 errors — already in chains `removed`; uncommitted catalog cleanup pending.
  - `cohere/north-mini-code:free`: 2/2 ok — keep, too little data.
  - Ollama `qwen2.5-coder:14b`: 8/8 ok but 0 tokens reported — zero-token success pattern (tokens_unreported_providers includes ollama).

### Failover health

- Chains source=file; circuits open=[]; half_open=[]; closed_tracked=1 (north-mini).
- Soft caps wired; spend day $0 / week $0.085 (fallover card) / month $40.81.
- SuperGrok guard respected (`supergrok_respect_guard=1`), locked today.
- Fallover rate 100% on n=1 turn (misleading headline; means the only instrumented turn needed a hop — and recovered).
- Hermes model hops since report: 3 sessions (flash→north-mini/deepseek-flash-0731; flash→grok-4.7×2). Stale open sessions in ledger: 20 (0 live); 15+ stalled >6h — cleanup recommended.

### Chat UX sample

- Last Chat (2026-09-28 16:40 PT): first model 404 (“unavailable for free”), failover hop 2 succeeded on north-mini-code in ~1.7s, cost $0.0002. User got an answer; wasted one dead-slug hop. Agents card: Chat quiet this morning; last activity that turn.

### HelpDesk

- No HelpDesk AI calls in usage_live windows. Main worktree has unresolved merge conflicts on HelpDesk TT templates (`new_ticket.tt`, `ticket_view.tt`) — not aisystem; do not touch :3001.

## Proposals

1. Add `openrouter|google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free` to chains `removed` and drop from chat/docs/title (allow-listed) — 100% errors / 7 calls.
2. Commit + reload uncommitted dead-slug catalog fix (code) so last-resort defaults cannot reintroduce nano:free.
3. Workstation: close/archive 20 stale Hermes open sessions; keep Super Grok guard lock while remaining 13% / reset Oct 1.
4. Configure `AI_EVAL_INGEST_TOKEN` or `~/.comserv/secrets/ai_eval_ingest_token` so inbox → `/ai/eval/ingest` becomes system-of-record upsert (currently inbox-only).
